observed_pattern: A class/script/marker/matrix row existed, so development was marked complete before compilation, consumer execution, or runtime proof.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Completion gate must require owner source + real consumer + positive/negative tests + compile + row-specific evidence.

observed_pattern: Documents and generated artifacts retained pre-push SHA after the overlay was committed.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Post-push gate must compare HEAD against every current report, marker, manifest, and evidence sourceSha/resultSha.

observed_pattern: Normal/error/recovery rows were mechanically generated from requirement text and all pointed at one broad evidence ID.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Each scenario must contain a concrete setup, command, expected result, failure signal, recovery assertion, and evidence artifact.

observed_pattern: One matrix success listed every QA33 ID, allowing unrelated rows to become complete.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Evidence producer must emit step-scoped IDs only; reclassifier must reject one evidence object that claims unrelated areas without per-row results.

observed_pattern: Wrappers referenced scripts that do not exist.
mandatory_prevention_gate: A cheap verifier-of-verifiers must resolve every script, parameter, task, fixture, and output path before any build/runtime work.

observed_pattern: Generator/verifier source changed, but OpenAPI/client/marker outputs remained legacy.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Generation contract changes must regenerate and commit canonical outputs in the same work unit, followed by clean-tree verification.

observed_pattern: Compilation, browsers, DBs, Kafka, and supply-chain were deferred to Codex while development status was already complete.
mandatory_prevention_gate: GPT work must run all available verification; environment-only steps remain unverified and cannot justify completion.

observed_pattern: Source remediation and separately owned README/guides were merged into one large push.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Session ownership and manifests must prevent unrelated parallel changes from being overwritten or reviewed together without approval.

observed_pattern: Gateway, Agent, and Batch independently implemented IP/CIDR/pinning rules.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Assign one owner for network identity primitives and reuse it through public API/SPI without reverse dependencies.

observed_pattern: Component evidence and matrix reclassification lacked a working canonical final index path.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Use an external immutable evidence bundle keyed by verified SHA and validate hashes/coverage without changing the verified source tree.

cause: Menu count treated as product completion
observed_pattern: Fifty-nine menu and route IDs were used as breadth evidence even when several menus shared one component or generic table and lacked workflow consumers.
mandatory_prevention_gate: A menu counts only when route, intended page state, generated operation, backend, permission, audit, positive/negative scenarios, and browser evidence are complete.

cause: Generic page reuse without workflow acceptance
observed_pattern: Batch runtime submenus were implemented as one-line wrappers over a dynamic table, making placeholder breadth look like dedicated commercial operations.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Generic framework components may be reused, but each feature must declare typed columns, filters, details, actions, error states, permissions and feature-specific acceptance tests.

cause: Minimum ADM capability baseline was not canonicalized
observed_pattern: Legacy commercial menu capabilities were reviewed informally but not converted into a maintained CPF capability matrix, so missing operational functions repeatedly resurfaced.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Maintain a canonical ADM capability matrix mapped to CPF owners and target quality; every major review compares actual menus/routes/consumers against it.

cause: Shared identifiers mistaken for integrated operations
observed_pattern: Online and Batch carried transaction/execution identifiers, but UI cross-navigation, causal timeline, permission and partial-data handling were not required for completion.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Integrated ADM completion requires executable cross-domain deep-link scenarios from transaction to Batch/Gateway/Incident/Audit and back.

cause: Frontend menu metadata became a parallel source of truth
observed_pattern: Labels, groups, routes and backend permission menu IDs are split across hardcoded frontend arrays and backend authorization data.
mandatory_prevention_gate: Use one canonical menu/capability registry or enforce generated parity across DB/API/frontend/router/permission/test artifacts.
